proof-admin — ProofStudio administration

Usage: proof-admin [--url <address>] [--json] <command> [options]

  login --email <email> [--password-stdin] [--code <code> --method totp|recovery]
  login --email <email> --method email, then login --method email --code <code>
  logout | status
  setup run --token-file <file>|--token-stdin --name <n> --email <e> --site <s> --company <c> [--seed-demo] [--builtin]
  setup status
  users list | users invite --email <e> --name <n> --scope <global|site:ID|company:ID> [--role <r>] [--link-file <f>]
  users suspend <id> | users activate <id> | users grant --user <id> --scope <s> --role <r> [--revoke]
  tenants list | tenants create-site --name <n> | tenants create-company --site <id> --name <n>
  tenants roles | tenants assign --subject <s> --roles <a,b> [--confirm-self-demotion]
  clients list | clients create --name <n> --scopes <a,b> [--minutes 15] [--origins <a,b>] --secret-file <f>
  clients rotate <id> --secret-file <f> | clients revoke <id> | tokens revoke <id>
  backups create --out <dir> | backups verify <dir> | backups restore <dir>
  license status | audit security [--limit 50]

Environment: PROOF_ADMIN_URL, PROOF_ADMIN_ORIGIN, PROOF_ADMIN_SESSION_FILE,
PROOF_ADMIN_PASSWORD, PROOF_ADMIN_SETUP_TOKEN, PROOF_ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN.
